data.one_liner: JSON Patch (RFC 6902) implementation for Dart using JSON Pointers.
data.what_it_does: Provides tools to build, encode, parse, and apply JSON Patch operations (Add, Copy, Move, Remove, Replace, Test) to JSON documents.
use_when: You need to modify JSON documents using the standard JSON Patch (RFC 6902) format.
You need to test, add, remove, replace, move, or copy values inside a JSON structure using JSON Pointers.
avoid_when: You only need simple JSON serialization without patching capabilities.
You need a full JSON schema validation library instead of document mutation.
strengths: Implements the official RFC 6902 standard completely.
Supports all core patch operations including Test, Remove, Add, Replace, Move, and Copy.
weaknesses: Limited documentation beyond basic README usage examples.
